scientific_question: Is the accepted c_fc directed-product decay-1 error-feedback replacement near-neutral at 5TPP when c_proj is restored to dense Muon, or was its apparently small contribution masked by the localized c_proj bottleneck in the joint run?

cproj_only.fact: c_proj-only stays within 0.005 CE of joint full MLP at every fixed checkpoint, so c_fc is not the primary joint bottleneck, but the missing c_fc-only factorial arm is needed to rule out masking or interaction.

rejected_activation_metric.fact: Raw post-GELU activation-energy weighting worsens the unweighted c_proj control at all checkpoints; the metric family is closed.

single_factor_ablation.parent: the exact rejected joint repaired-attention full-MLP v2 configuration

retain: repaired attention Cayley structure and optimizer
c_fc family radius 1.0 and ridge ratio 1e-6

implementation_guard.required_change: The launch validator previously admitted directed-product c_fc only when the generated Muon-matched-Givens c_proj flag was enabled. Permit the scientifically stronger dense-c_proj control when mlp.c_proj is absent from block_fht_targets, while continuing to reject every unqualified generated c_proj.
implementation_guard.scope: validation-only control admission; no model, optimizer, update, initialization, schedule, or loss math changes
test_requirements: the exact c_fc-only config parses with dense c_proj
directed-product c_fc with an unqualified generated c_proj remains rejected
candidate c_fc initialization and optimizer wiring remain covered by the existing directed-product tests

decision_rule.pass_action: If terminal CE is at most 3.6478 and the full fixed curve has no material regression, accept c_fc-only as the partial MLP replacement and quantify the retained trainable-parameter reduction and empirical compute penalty.
decision_rule.fail_action: If terminal CE exceeds 3.6478, reject the c_fc chart at 5TPP; do not tune or scale it. Use the factorial curve to classify c_fc/c_proj interaction before selecting a new full-MLP representation.

performance_gate.protocol: Foreground exact-scientific-config run with one warmup plus eight timed real training updates; poll directly and use no watchdog.

monitoring.callback_action_prompt: verify the live or terminal state against the active project note, inspect fixed loss and GPU health, update durable state, and continue the causal MLP plan autonomously

execution.mfu_polling: foreground direct polling without watchdog; expected below five minutes
